214695: Letizia Collini: Letizia Collini is a vibrant, soul-rooted vocalist and artist whose sound blends modern soul, pop, and rock. Accompanied by a 5-piece band, she performs original music and reimagined classic songs with groove-driven arrangements, gospel influences, and a classic soul feel.
Tags: Music, Concert, Groove, Live Music, Format, Performance, September 12
214697: The Music of Earth, Wind & Fire ft. The Black Soul Experience: Join us for a special tribute to Earth, Wind & Fire featuring The Black Soul Experience. Antwon Robinson and his allstar band will be celebrating this timeless music with incredible renditions of the hits and deep cuts alike!
Tags: Music, Concert, Soul Music, Tribute Band, Live Music, Earth Wind and Fire, Format, Performance
214699: The Dante Max Band: The Dante Max Band bridges the gap between the golden era of soul and the chart-toppers of today. Specializing in high-energy covers, the band takes audiences on a sonic journey from the infectious grooves of 70s Motown straight through to the modern R&B and pop hits of the 2000s-2020s. Whether they are channeling the grit of Teddy Swims or the swagger of Bruno Mars, the Dante Max Band delivers a performance that is both musically tight and impossible not to dance to.
Tags: Music, Concert, Band, Groove, Live Music, Format, Performance
214700: Moon Soul: Moon Soul is a high-energy soul and rock band from New York City—a fun, funny, crowd-interactive outfit that blends the sounds of Sly & the Family Stone, The Zombies, Fela Kuti, and The Police into something funky and totally original.
Tags: Music, Concert, Soul Music, Groove, Live Music, Format, Performance
214701: The Music of D'Angelo ft Bel-Ami: Join Bel-Ami, Errick Lewis, Miles Robertson, Roni Tabara, Leroy “Lefty” Thompson, Wayne Tucker, and MJ Songstress as they pay tribute to one of the most influential musicians of our time. Expect smooth grooves, deep funk, and feel-good vibes all night long with the music of D’Angelo.
